notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.notes: The "all opinions" achievement is now easier to achieve.

notes.title: Charlie and Harry fix
notes.notes:
There was an issue that some opinions of Harry and Charlie could not be collected. This has now been fixed: Harry's opinion had simply not been displayed which is now automatically fixed when you restart the game. Charlie's opinion could previously not been obtained due to a bug. You can  now visit Charlie at his home in the "blue" scenario to collect it. 
Thank you for reporting this bug and for your patience.

notes.title: Taiwanese and all achievements
notes.notes:
We have included a Taiwanese localization (so far only a first version that we will improve further) and have also fixed one more bug in the achievements that prevented some players from achieving the final achievements. 
We apologize for the delays and thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Achievements fix
notes.notes:
Achievements seemed to be fixed now for everyone. If you had any achievements not registered in the past days, please restart the game and you should get them automatically. Please let us know if there are any achievements still missing then.
We deeply apologize again for the error that caused this issue. 
Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Achievements fix
notes.notes: There were still problems with the achievements. I hope they are fixed now. Thank you for your patience and please apologize this problem.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.notes: We fixed some minor bugs, in particular regarding achievements.

notes.title: Let's Play: Sweet Science, the award-winning visual novel!
notes.notes:
[h1]Sweet Science – The Girls of Silversee Castle[/h1]
Travel back to the 1990s to a mysterious boarding school, meet four nerdy girls, go on adventures, find the way back to your time – or maybe win the heart of your dream girl!
We'll play the first day of this visual novel where you will meet Azuki, the spaced-out anime girl, Marie, the timid, super smart child protegee, Patti, who doesn't miss a chance to set something on fire, and Baroness Sylvia who anyway feels way above you minor creatures...
We're going to have loads of fun together, so don't forget to tune into this stream!

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2309230/ss_13f74dbb37380d3c27da9a8cca158621df1f82c8.1920x1080.jpg?t=1714359108[/img]

[h3]Get "Sweet Science" now for free on Steam, but also check out our new game [b]The Beautiful Island[/b]![/h3]

notes.title: The Beautiful Island – Game play and a talk with the author
notes.notes:
The lead author of [b]"The Beautiful Island"[/b] will present the game to you. He will also answer questions from players about the background of the story and how the game was made. 
Of course, there will also be some time for a quick look at other games from TLS, "Sweet Science" and "The Last Secret".
